text:
reeva: Dropped a focused PR to clarify minutely rollups and the billing preview CSV + replace legacy header examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7345
reeva: Key asks: (1) add a tiny minutely timeline that shows how burst credits are consumed per-minute before rolling into the 30d invoice, (2) provide a Go SDKv2 snippet for setting the usage header, (3) swap out any hard grafana panel anchors for the durable slug links.
oscar: grabbing this. For the Go snippet I'll use the canonical JSON header form but redacted: `X-Redwood-Usage: {"account":"acct_900","units":75,"unit_type":"tokens"}`. Will also add a curl snippet with <REDACTED> key.
maria: nice. Please also include two PromQL examples for copy-paste: minute view `sum(rate(redwood_tokens_total[1m])) by (account)` and invoice window `sum(increase(redwood_tokens_total[30d])) by (account)`.
infra-bot: Note: grafana panel ids are different between staging and prod. Recommend linking to `/d/usage/overview` and append `?var-account=$account` if you need preselection. Avoid `panelId` anchors. OPS ticket OPS-2210 opened for anchor redirects.
oscar: Go snippet to add:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
req := redwood.NewGenerateRequest("Summarize...")
req.Headers.Set("X-Redwood-Usage", `{"account":"acct_900","units":75,"unit_type":"tokens"}`)
_, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), req)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
```
reeva: also call out cache behavior in one short sentence: cache hits do not incur forward-pass token billing; only cache misses and finalization frames increment counters.
maria: editorial nit: change tier label 'starter' -> 'growth' in the pricing table and add a one-line legacy mapping. Also reword quota wording from "requests blocked" to "requests may 429 or be routed to a fallback model depending on routing policy".
oscar: fixed the CSV math and added a sample Google Sheets formula in the PR notes showing tokens -> kTokens conversion for per-kToken pricing. Also uploaded /examples/billing-preview-7345.csv.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-7345--docs.redwood.ai  please check the header snippet formatting in both code blocks and prose, and verify the timeline SVG renders on staging.
reeva: I'll do a final pass on preview and merge if green. Target: ship before EOD to align with the billing preview release. Ping me if anything 404s. :thumbsup:
